"Young Master Huang, I'm sorry. It's my fault for not raising my son well. I'm useless, so I raised such a rebellious son. I'm sorry to you, to Young Master Meng. Fang Shunli remained silent. He had already made up his mind: he needed a scapegoat, and Fang Tianyou, the culprit, was clearly a good choice. As for Fang Kunlong, he would try to persuade him to continue working. If he couldn't, then he would just give up. In a situation like this, the only thing to do was to cut losses as much as possible and prevent them from escalating.

paragraphs: Zhao An was fully aware of every movement in the ward. The joy of his successful plan fueled his excitement as he thrust into the women, fucking both his aunt and younger aunt.

However, when his grandmother got up in the middle of the night to use the bathroom, she heard moans coming from her daughter's room. They were clearly the sounds of sex! She was briefly surprised, but quickly shook her head and chose not to dwell on it. While curious, she also knew her daughter was grown and had her own freedom. She could do whatever she wanted, and she would neither oppose nor support it.

Early the next morning, Zhao An climbed off Qian Yuling again. Of all the women, Qian Yuling held the greatest allure. Perhaps because he had put in so much effort and the price was so high, every time he fucked Qian Yuling, he felt the urge to recoup his investment, which naturally led to his extra ferocity.

As soon as he woke up, he saw his aunt, who had gotten up early, emerge from the bathroom, clutching a pregnancy test stick—the latest model. If you're pregnant, a plus sign will appear; if you're not, a minus sign. This test is more effective than traditional two-bar pregnancy tests.
Seeing Zhao An's smirk, my aunt lowered her head somewhat sheepishly and whispered, "Honey, I'm pregnant!"

Zhao An pulled my aunt into his arms and kissed her on the lips. "If you're pregnant, give birth. This is the fruit of our love. Just focus on taking care of the baby. Don't worry about anything else, okay?"

My aunt hugged Zhao An tightly, but her heart was filled with mixed feelings. She'd said she wanted to bear a man's child, but when she got pregnant, she still felt a strange feeling. The father was only seventeen, and she, at her age, had been raped by a younger man. It was one thing to have been raped, but getting pregnant was a bit too much.
"I understand, honey. I'll take good care of it. I want to give you a healthy baby." My aunt said with a hint of shyness. Since it had already happened, I might as well just accept it.

"Well, go tell my mom. I'll go explore the village later and see if there's anything good to invest in. I'll have dinner with you then. I'm looking forward to the moment when your belly and your cousin's belly both get bigger!" Zhao An bit his aunt's earlobe. The thought of mother and daughter getting pregnant together was truly sinister.
My aunt didn't get angry after hearing this. Instead, she covered her mouth with her hand and giggled softly, "That child doesn't know how much she wants to get pregnant. She really likes you."
After a few tender moments, Zhao An went to have breakfast.

"Grandma, what are we having for breakfast?" Zhao An saw that only his grandmother was busy in the kitchen. His mother was pregnant and hadn't gotten up. It was normal for his aunt and cousin to be unable to get up now after being tormented by him for several hours last night. They needed to rest and recover.
"Noodles, I wonder if you're used to it." Grandma's smile was gentle. The feeling of having so many children and grandchildren was wonderful; the only drawback was the lack of male offspring.

As for my aunt's son, he had been marginalized. Zhao An disliked him, so my aunt didn't dare pursue him. She could only give him some money and let him fend for himself. Otherwise, returning home to see his mother being raped by his cousin would be torture and humiliation.

"It's okay, I'll eat it all. Just cook more. Grandma, you're still very beautiful. I'm sure there are many people in the village who like you," Zhao An offered a false compliment. He had no thoughts about Grandma yet, despite her well-maintained appearance. His focus was more on his aunts and cousins.

"Haha, my dear grandson is really good at talking. Grandma is old, and in the countryside, there's no such thing as likes or dislikes." Grandma's smile was gentle, with a hint of amusement in it. As an elementary school teacher, she had always had a stable job. Accustomed to living alone, she didn't accept any advances.

The countryside was still relatively simple, and no one dared to rape. Although my grandmother had many suitors, none of them succeeded. Now retired, she mostly spent her time growing vegetables, chatting with the neighbors, and then going to bed. Her life was simple, yet it was also filled with a certain enjoyment.
"Haha, I'm telling the truth." Zhao An left after dinner, not staying long.
A while after Zhao An left, my aunt yawned and came downstairs. "Mom, did you make breakfast?"
"Why are you so tired after a long night's sleep? Did we have guests last night?" Grandma asked with a smile, a hint of confusion in her heart.

My aunt's face flushed slightly, but she could hide it by saying she looked healthy in the morning. Actually, there was a guest in her room last night: Zhao An. He had been fucked to the point of ecstasy, and only her daughter, Jia Li, had come to her rescue. Even so, she was still filled with a large amount of semen, and there's still semen residue in her uterus! "No, I'm hungry, so I came down to get something to eat."

"It's in the kitchen, in the pot. Just fill it up yourself. Where's your eldest sister? Why hasn't she gotten up yet?" Grandma smiled, her expression still kind, but a hint of doubt lingered in her heart. What exactly happened last night?
Even on the other side, Zhao An held his phone, which contained a report from Dean Qin.

"Young Master An, Huang Meng and Fang Tianyou are still in critical condition. We've been ordered from above to treat them with all our strength!" Dean Qin complained bitterly. He was only a year away from retirement, and after the Chinese New Year, there was only half a year left. Couldn't he just have some peace and quiet? Why were there always so many things going on?

"Why don't you just ask them to go to Hengdu? Hengdu has more experts, so you can just push them out. You're almost retired anyway, so they won't give you any trouble if you say that." Zhao An said nonchalantly. He just wanted these two guys to suffer.

Huang Meng isn't a good man, and Fang Tianyou isn't a good person either. They're both beasts who exploit power and money to play with women. Besides playing with women, they've also committed numerous acts of torture and bullying.
In this respect, at least, Zhao An is a truly good man. He wouldn't actively harm anyone. Picking up girls is one thing, playing with women is another; at most, he's just lustful.
In this comparison, Zhao An might have thought for a moment that he was a saint, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 740 Buying things for women
paragraphs: Most of the farmland in Xinghua Village lay abandoned, with only a small portion being cultivated. These cultivated fields were cultivated because the owners were at home, not working outside. The remaining residents, mostly children and the elderly, were unable to cultivate the land, leaving it to waste.
Zhao An's second uncle accompanied him on a tour of the village. He was most familiar with the area and could provide Zhao An with a detailed introduction.
He greeted villagers he knew along the way. Whenever someone asked, he would tell them that Zhao An was his nephew, seemingly unaware that his wife had been raped twice by the man before him.
His cousin, Lai Fu, was also helping out. Second aunt had asked him to come and help out, perhaps by running errands.
Looking at the abandoned farmland, Zhao An was lost in thought. "Okay, let's go down the mountain and take a look. I'm planning to lease a piece of land for livestock farming."

"You should discuss this with your uncle. He's the village Party Secretary. He went to town for a meeting the day before yesterday and should be back soon today." The second uncle spoke frankly. A village Party Secretary in a poor area is just that, handling some civil matters, forget about anything else.

"My uncle is the village Party Secretary?" Zhao An's expression was a little strange. It was true. In the past, he might have been excited, but now, even with the director in his presence, he remained unmoved. When you get used to something, the next time it happens, you naturally become numb.
"Yes, when he comes back, you can go visit his house. His home is in the back village, and we're in the front village," the second uncle explained.

In fact, Xinghua Village is a combination of Fengqian Village and the back village. People used to gather like that. Some settled here, some there, and over time, they settled down. They were all part of the same village, just a bit far apart.
"Okay, I'll visit him when he gets back," Zhao An said with a smile. Suddenly, he saw a vehicle approaching: a truck.
When the truck arrived, it promptly unloaded the New Year's goods it had brought—a mix of dry goods, daily necessities, and clothing—and began selling them through a loudspeaker.
"The sales truck is here. Lai Fu, go check it out and buy some New Year's goods," Second Uncle instructed. "Xiao An, we're on our way."

Zhao An waved his hand. "I've already picked out the place. No need to go over. Just a liking is enough. We can chat over lunch. I'll go buy some things for my cousins. By the way, Second Uncle, please ask the owners of those plots of land if they're interested in selling. I'm giving you this phone. It'll make things easier. Consider it a gift from me. Don't refuse. You'll need your help with a lot of things in the future, and a phone will be more convenient."

Second Uncle was about to decline. The family only had one phone. A cell phone? That would cost a fortune every month, and their family couldn't afford it. This showed how poor Xinghua Village was. It was truly poor. There weren't many good ways to make money in the mountains.
"Okay, Xiao An, don't worry. I'll take care of everything you've entrusted to me." Second Uncle-in-Law was a sincere man. Seeing Zhao An's demeanor, he immediately patted his chest and promised.

Zhao An waved his hand. "No need to be so confident. Just do your best. By the way, take this thousand yuan and buy some cigarettes and alcohol. Negotiations still require cigarettes, alcohol, and tea. They're essential. Don't skimp. Take it."
"This, this can't be done. I can't take any more of your money." Second Uncle-in-Law didn't want to take the money at all. It was against the rules.

"I told you this is activity funds, not for you. It's for negotiation. Take it. I'll leave these matters to you, Second Uncle-in-Law. I have some other things to take care of. I'll go see Second Aunt first." Zhao An shoved the money into Second Uncle-in-Law's hands and went to the truck to pick out some clothes.
These clothes were actually quite cheap, but they had been transported so far here that the prices were a bit high. Many rural residents simply looked and didn't buy; they simply couldn't afford it!
Zhao An didn't care. After buying a few pieces of clothing, he returned to his second uncle's house.
Upon entering, he saw his cousin Huizhi preparing to leave. "Sister, what are you doing?"
"I'm going back to take care of some things. Andi, you can have dinner here. I need to go back for a bit and come back later." Huizhi smiled gently. She was still young and shouldn't be a widow.

"Sister, after the New Year, come back with me. I need your help. I need someone to do my laundry and cooking. You can be my nanny first, and then you can learn other skills. My company is getting bigger, and I need someone I can trust to help me. I'll also be taking Lanzhi to the city to study, so you can look after her then," Zhao An suddenly suggested, intending to pack up the two sisters and his second aunt and leave together!
Huizhi's eyes lit up with joy, then dimmed again. "Well, let's talk about this later. My mother-in-law is still home, and I need to discuss this with her."
"Okay, I have plenty of help. Aunt Lin can help, too. I'll tell her. I'm just worried she won't come with us. Sister, you've worked hard." Zhao An gave his cousin a hug, a deep one.
Huizhi was a little surprised, but she obeyed. "Thank you, I'm fine."
"Sister, if you have any problems in the future, just tell me. I'll definitely help you." Zhao An released Huizhi and looked at her seriously. "I mean anything!"

Huizhi's heart fluttered at the sight, and she felt a little shy. She reminded herself that she was Zhao An's cousin and couldn't let anything slip into her mind. "I understand, Xiao An. You're so kind!"
After watching Huizhi leave, Zhao An gave the remaining clothes to his second aunt.

Second Aunt was preparing dinner, sorting through a bunch of vegetables. Seeing Zhao An, she grumbled, "Xiao An, don't be so polite. Second Aunt is so happy you're here, so why are you spending so much money? Are you treating her like an outsider?"
Zhao An laughed heartily. "No, I've always treated Second Aunt like one of my own. Where's Lanzhi? I bought her a little gift, too. I'll give it to her."
"It's in the west room. Just give it to her. Don't be polite. Go ahead." Second Aunt said that, but she was still very happy. Sex aside, she also liked Zhao An from the bottom of her heart.
